PROPERTIES.player_hint_1_en: Suppose Barnaby were at row 3, column 3: then Amber would have nowhere left to go. So Barnaby can't be there. So Barnaby (B) must be at row 1, column 1. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_2_en: With the rows and columns of Barnaby crossed out, only one square is left for Dante that fits his clue ("He was beside the shelf."). So Dante (D) must be at row 2, column 4. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_3_en: With the rows and columns of Barnaby and Dante crossed out, only one square is left for Elsa that fits her clue ("She was beside some flowers."). So Elsa (E) must be at row 3, column 3. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_4_en: Cecily's own clue ("Someone else in her area was sitting in a chair.") rules out more squares. Cecily is now the only person who can still go in column 2. So Cecily (C) must be at row 4, column 2. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_5_en: With the rows and columns of everyone placed so far crossed out, only one square is left for Amber that fits her clue ("She was beside a table in the Library."). So Amber (A) must be at row 5, column 5. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_6_en: With the rows and columns of everyone placed so far crossed out, only one square is left for Vince. So Vince (the victim) must be at row 6, column 6. Cross out his row and column. Amber is the only person in the Library with Vince, so Amber is the murderer!

CHARACTERS.char_quote_en_0: She was beside a table in the Library.
CHARACTERS.char_quote_en_1: He was sitting in a chair in the Conservatory.
CHARACTERS.char_quote_en_2: Someone else in her area was sitting in a chair.
CHARACTERS.char_quote_en_5: The Victim. He was alone with the murderer.
